title_as_printed: मुंबई निदेशालय मास्टर लेजर — कान्होजीआंग्रेदीपस्तंभ/ Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse

sections.title: Optical equipment

fields.label: No. of panels
fields.value: 6 nos. clear ‘’Bulls Eye’’ Acrylic panels spaced at 60(Hexagonal)

fields.label: Arrangement Of lamps
fields.value: WM FL 1006 place automatic 12V, C8 pre- focused 6 nos. 12V/50W Marine Halogen Lamps

sections.text: Divergence, Mains and Emergency are printed as three sub-labels in one cell with a single multi-line value cell. Section continues from page 1 to page 2.

sections.title: Source of energy
sections.text:
Solar panels Make Tata BP,16 nos. 74W.
Solar panels Make MONO, crystalline 12 nos. 200W.

fields.label: Buildings
fields.value: Power House, Boat shed, pump house, Light keepers dwellings, Gr.D hut, cook house

fields.label: Compound Lights
fields.value: 20 nos. (Solar street lights, 12/40AH battery and 40W solar panal)

sections.title: Mode of approach
sections.text: By bus up to Thal then by motor launch up to lighthouse

sections.title: Facilities available
sections.text: High School, Dispensary, Police station And Post office at Alibaug approx. 10 Km. from Lighthouse

sections.title: Postal address
sections.text: Head Light keeper, KanhojiAngre Lighthouse, Post Office Thal, Dist. Raigad.

fields.label: Date of commissioning
fields.value: April 1887 (Taken over from Mumbai Port Trust on 11.10.2007)

sections.title: Automation Equipment

fields.label: Comprising of
fields.value:
a) Indoor unit (IDU) for communication
b) Programmable Logical Controller
c) Human Machine Interface(HMI)
d) Input/Output Module (STB)
e) Ethernet Switch 16 Ports 10/100 Dest top Switching
f) Ethernet Gateway ( Modbus to Ethernet converter)
g) Power supply for various modules in RTU
i) 24 to 24 V DC-DC converter
ii) 24 to 12V DC-DC converter
h) Power supply for RTU
i) 12 V 26 AH- 4 Nos

fields.label: Charger for RTU Battery
fields.value: 24V, 20 A SMPS “Power Engineering” Make( For Charging the RTU battery)- 1 No

fields.label: V-SAT Communication Equipment
fields.value:
a)1.8m dia Parabolic reflecto ( Microwave Dish Antenna)
b)Outdoor Unit (ODU) for communication
c) Block Up Converter(BUC) and Low noise block (LNB) convert

fields.label: Transducer
fields.value:
a) Power line meter
b) DC signal isolator
c) Proximity switch

sections.text: Section continues from page 3 to page 4.

sections.title: Other Vital Aids
sections.text: Static sensor station having high end surveillance RADAR, Electro Optic Sensors (CCD Day Camera and Thermal Imagers), VHF sets and Meteorological equipment’s.

name: Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse
ledger_issues: Two divergence sets given: 4.48°/3.26° and 'Main 5° 03’ (Horizontal) 4° 59’ (Vertical)'; first set used
Duration of Flash 'Main 3 sec.' is inconsistent with fl (2) 10 Sec character
Rotation Device '---' although R.P.M. 3 and rotating beacon listed
Colours W and R given but no sector bearings stated
